title: New Features
meta: Plan, build and release a new feature your users have asked for, tested and shipped to your product. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: New features for your SaaS, planned and shipped
overview: We take a feature your users keep asking for and turn it into a shipped release. First we write a short spec with you, covering what it does and how it fits your product. Then we design the screens, build it on a branch in your repository, test it and release it. You get working code, tests and short notes for your support team so they can explain it to users.

pkgs.blurb: One small feature, specified, built and tested.
A mid-size feature with design, edge cases and a staged release.
A larger feature or two small ones, shipped with support notes.

faq: Can you build a feature in a codebase you have not seen?
Yes. We read the code first and tell you how the feature fits before building. If the code makes the feature risky or too large for the package, we say so and suggest a smaller first step.
You do. Everything is committed to your own repository, and we do not reuse your code for other clients. You keep the spec, designs and tests as well.
What if the feature is bigger than the package?
We split it into a first release that fits and a written plan for the rest. You get something working and shippable, and the remaining parts can be a second order.
Do you add analytics to the feature?
With the top package, yes. We add events so you can see who uses the feature and where they drop off. For smaller packages we can add it as an extra.
